title: Especialista de tesouraria
description:
Sobre a empresa:

Multinacional de grande porte, reconhecida globalmente por sua forte atuação no segmento em que opera e por seu compromisso contínuo com inovação e alta performance. Com presença consolidada em diversos mercados, entrega soluções tecnológicas que impulsionam produtividade, sustentabilidade e resultados consistentes aos seus clientes.

Atividades:

  • Realizar as atividades da tesouraria, incluindo a gestão do fluxo de caixa e a análise de contas bancárias;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das políticas financeiras e a eficiência dos processos de controle;
  • Planejar e executar operações de captação de recursos financeiros, gestão de riscos financeiros e câmbio;
  • Acompanhar os investimentos e as necessidades de financiamento da empresa;
  • Desenvolver relatórios e apresentações financeiras para a alta gestão;
  • Ser referência técnica para a equipe de tesouraria, promovendo a integração e auxiliando na melhoria contínua dos processos da área;
  • Participar de contatos e reuniões com bancos e/ou instituições financeiras;
  • Gerenciar a exposição cambial da empresa, incluindo a contratação de derivativos e proteção contra riscos cambiais;
  • Realizar operações de importação e exportação, assegurando eficiência nos processos financeiros relacionados;
  • Gerenciar a gestão de dívidas, incluindo captação de recursos, contratação de empréstimos e garantias;
  • Realizar o controle de contas a pagar e receber no exterior, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas financeiras da matriz;
  • Negociar taxas e condições com bancos e instituições financeiras, fortalecendo o relacionamento bancário;
  • Executar negociações de câmbios específicos, assegurando as melhores condições para a empresa;
  • Monitorar e controlar o fluxo de caixa diário, projeções financeiras, resgates e controle de mútuos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores da área para avaliar o desempenho financeiro e apoiar a Direção tomada de decisões estratégicas.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação Completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas, Economia e áreas afins;
  • Pós-Graduação Completa em áreas correlatas será um diferencial;
  • Experiência anterior na função;
  • Conhecimento em risco cambial, captações e gestão do caixa;
  • Experiência em indústria multinacional será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento avançado na língua inglesa.

title: Arquitetura de Tecnologia DevSecOps
description:

O que você precisa para ser um Ituber?

Estamos em busca de profissionais protagonistas, que se envolvam nas solicitações, estabeleçam parcerias com as áreas, contribuam com ideias para construção de boas soluções, que esteja atenta às boas práticas de mercado, dissemine conhecimento e auxilie na construção e evolução das tech products, com arquiteturas inovadoras e competitivas afim de viabilizar soluções resilientes, eficientes, seguras e escaláveis.

  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho e custos das soluções em nuvem.

  • Experiência em visibilidade e otimização de custos em ambientes de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento em governança financeira e alocação de custos.
  • Habilidade em criar relatórios e análises financeiras para planejamento de capacidade.

title: Murex ERM Consultant
description:
Project description

DXC Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration. We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology, or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities

Consultants should be comfortable with at least one asset class (example: Commodities, FXO, FI etc) and show experience of implementation or client support.

Part of an embedment team, candidates will be part of Murex application support / build team performing the following responsibilities:

Resolve daily Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) issues on both functional, valuation, and pricing

Liaise with the technical team(s) -

when needed -

to resolve ERM related issues and necessary enhancements

Develop ERM Business requirements per given stream and according to Project needs as they come along

Products (IRD, CRD, EQD, FXD) management and validation

Manage day-to-day assigned project tasks to complete various ERM deliverables

Contribute and assist existing support group(s) in resolving requests or issues with ERM, VaR, P&L, Market Data, and booking issues

Analyze, formulate, propose, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

Continuous follow-up of new Market regulations/practices globally

Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

Ability to utilize specialized knowledge on financial derivatives and Murex software to participate in implementation and upgrade projects throughout scoping, design, build and validation phases.

Provide high-quality support in using the Murex platform for pricing and structuring of complex financial products within trading domain (e.g. FX derivatives, interest rates derivatives, Fixed Income etc).

Develop test cases to troubleshoot the system, document defective use cases for fixes by developers. Market Risk, Credit Risk/MLC, xVA - Junior:

2-3 years' experience in financial markets and products

Technical skills in SQL, XML, Unix and Scripting

Experience with MX.3

Good communication skills

Skills

Must have

Strong analytical, pricing, and ERM skills

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Strong presentation skills

Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally

Strong experience in supporting FO users and resolving their daily issues

Must:

2+ years experience on Murex with Market Risk, Credit Risk/MLC, xVA functionalities/module

1+ years of experience in financial markets/IT business analysis

Technical skills in SQL, XML, Unix and Scripting

Experience with MX.3

Proficient in English

Good communication skills

Must have a strong personality, logical and analytical skills

Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Possess good verbal and written communication skills

Must have strong organization skills

Nice to have

BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics or equivalent

Implementations and upgrades

Test management

Trade life cycle management

Market Data management

Knowledge in SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase) and Unix commands is a plus

Good understanding of Market Risk Management (including VaR, stress-tests, back-testing)

Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.

Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.

Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.

Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.

Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.

  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

title: Estagiário em Remuneração e Budget
description:
CONHEÇA UM POUCO SOBRE O GROUPE SEB:

Facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.

Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo.

Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.

Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas.

Sua missão:

A posição de Estagiário de Remuneração, Budget, Mobilidade Global e People Analytics desempenha um papel multifacetado na área de Recursos Humanos de uma organização, fornecendo suporte vital para atividades relacionadas à gestão dessas áreas . Este papel é crucial para garantir a equidade salarial, o controle de despesas, o planejamento financeiro e a facilitação de processos de mobilidade global da empresa, além de transformar dados em informações relevantes para tomada de decisão.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Suporte na Análise de Remuneração: Auxiliar na coleta e análise de dados relacionados à remuneração dos colaboradores, incluindo aqueles em mobilidade global. Isso envolve a revisão de informações sobre salários, benefícios e políticas de expatriação, garantindo a equidade salarial e a conformidade com regulamentos locais e internacionais.
  • Participação em Pesquisas Salariais: Contribuir para a realização de pesquisas salariais, incluindo aquelas específicas para colaboradores em mobilidade global. Analisar tendências do mercado e fazer recomendações sobre ajustes na estrutura de remuneração.
  • Assistência na Elaboração do Orçamento de Pessoal: Apoiar a equipe na preparação e manutenção do orçamento de pessoal da empresa.
  • Colaboração no Processo de Planejamento Financeiro: Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios e análises financeiras relacionadas aos custos de pessoal, incluindo aqueles relacionados à mobilidade global.
  • Gestão da Mobilidade Global: Prestar suporte administrativo e operacional para processos de mobilidade global, incluindo a coordenação de vistos, autorizações de trabalho, realocação, alojamento e benefícios para expatriados.
  • Manutenção de Dados e Documentação: Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados relacionados à remuneração, orçamento e mobilidade global, mantendo registros atualizados e precisos. Isso inclui a criação e manutenção de documentação relevante, como políticas de remuneração, procedimentos de orçamento e diretrizes de mobilidade.
  • Suporte Administrativo Geral: Prestar assistência administrativa geral à equipe de Recursos Humanos, conforme necessário, ajudando em tarefas como organização de arquivos, agendamento de reuniões e comunicação com colaboradores.

O que você precisa ter para fazer parte desse time:

  • Cursando a partir do 2º ano de graduação, Administração de empresas, Engenharias Estatística, Matemática, Economia e áreas afins.
  • Estudar no período noturno, com disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas/dia;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office Avançado.
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Formação prevista a partir de 06/2027.

O que você encontrará na SEB?

  • Bolsa auxílio de acordo com o ano da graduação.

Para Cuidados com a sua saúde:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar.

Para cuidados com o seu Bem- Estar:

title: Analista de Contabilidade SR
description:
A Ademicon é mais do que uma empresa: é uma marca que realiza! Planejamos não só a conquista dos clientes, mas também a carreira de quem quer ser especialista no que faz. Aqui, as portas estão abertas para você mostrar seu talento não só para nós, mas para TODOS!

Somos uma empresa líder em consórcio há mais de 30 anos, que olha para frente e está à procura de profissionais que queiram conquistar ainda mais.

Nossa expansão vem tomando forma pelo mundo inteiro, com mais de 200 unidades de négocio, mais de 5000 consultores e licenciados, e um time corporativo com mais de 400 colaboradores. Em 2024, a companhia conseguiu atingir a incrível marca de +84 bilhões em créditos comercializados e +295 mil clientes atendidos.

Mas esses números só são possíveis com a nossa gente, que faz a marca acontecer e leva adiante tudo o que acreditamos. E, claro, acreditamos em VOCÊ!

Principais responsabilidades

• Apoiar diretamente o Gerente Contábil na revisão e aprimoramento dos processos internos da

área.

• Identificar oportunidades de automação de rotinas contábeis e propor soluções práticas.

• Participar da estruturação de controles e políticas contábeis que garantam maior robustez e

conformidade.

• Atuar na análise crítica de lançamentos, conciliações e demonstrações contábeis, contribuindo

para a melhoria contínua.

• Colaborar na implementação de melhorias sistêmicas e integração entre áreas (contábil, fiscal,

financeiro).

• Contribuir com visão técnica e estratégica para projetos de transformação contábil.

• Apoiar na preparação de informações para auditoria externa e órgãos reguladores.

• Participar da construção de indicadores e relatórios gerenciais que suportem a tomada de

decisão.

Requisitos

• Sólidos conhecimentos em contabilidade societária e normas brasileiras (CPCs).

• Experiência com conciliações contábeis, fechamento mensal e elaboração de demonstrações

financeiras.

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager

dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. They will work closely with the client’s teams to understand their requirements and ensure that our tools are fit for purpose.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of P&P Products: Ensure the timely and successful delivery of price and promotion software solutions that meet client’s needs and objectives, in line with the project plan. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.
  • Drive Change: Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client teams, guiding them through change by implementing new price and promotional processes. Work closely with the product teams to influence the roadmap based on clients’ feedback and develop new features collaboratively.
  • Process & Requirements Documentation: Understand and document the client’s current processes, identify and organize their business and process requirements, and work with the Price & Promotion Consulting Director and the wider team to recommend best-in-class solutions.
  • Software Configuration & Testing: Configure enterprise price and promotions software to align with specific client processes and needs. Develop and implement internal and external testing processes. Perform testing and analysis of data to ensure accuracy and effectiveness of software solutions.
  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Analista de P&D Analítico Pleno
description:
Atividades:

  • Pesquisar, desenvolver e validar métodos analíticos de identificação, doseamento, dissolução, impurezas e/ou resíduos para matérias-primas e produtos acabados, empregando técnicas como espectrofotometria (UV-VIS), cromatografia líquida de alta eficiência (HPLC), cromatografia gasosa (CG) e absorção atômica (AA).
  • Assegurar a adequabilidade das metodologias farmacopeicas de matérias primas e produtos acabados para garantir a sua reprodutibilidade nas condições do laboratório.
  • Realizar as análises necessárias para dar o suporte analítico para as áreas de interface, durante o desenvolvimento de produto.
  • Realizar a análise crítica dos resultados das análises realizadas durante o desenvolvimento de produto (sejam elas internas ou externas), de forma a garantir a confiabilidade dos resultados.
  • Elaborar a documentação necessária aos processos de registros, renovação de registros ou alterações pós-registro, bem como o cumprimento de exigências.
  • Realizar a transferência de metodologias analíticas, garantindo a correta execução do procedimento analítico.
  • Realizar a análise crítica dos indicadores do setor visando garantir as entregas dentro dos prazos estipulados.
  • Elaborar e realizar treinamentos dos procedimentos operacionais relacionados ao processo de desenvolvimento analítico, garantindo a disseminação das informações e padronizando as atividades, bem como de conhecimentos adquiridos em projetos, replicação de treinamentos externos e normas e legislações que impactam nas rotinas de trabalho.
  • Participar do processo de qualificações dos equipamentos da área, para garantir a confiabilidade dos resultados gerados.
  • Realizar o levantamento, orçamento e requisição de compra de materiais e equipamentos necessários para o desenvolvimento das atividades.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior: Química, Farmácia, ou áreas afins.
  • LÍNGUA INGLESA - Conhecimento básico em língua inglesa.
  • BPF (Boas Práticas de Fabricação) - Garantir o cumprimento das BPF.
  • BPL (BOAS PRÁTICAS DE LABORATÓRIO) - Cumprir com as BPL.
  • Domínio das técnicas instrumentais, tais como HPLC, GC, FTIR, espectrofotometria UV etc.
  • Domínio das análises físico-químicas tais como titulação, CCD, gravimetria, desintegração, friabilidade, dureza, polarimetria etc.
  • Utilizar o gerenciador eletrônico nos processos de elaboração e revisão de documentos.
  • Capacidade para redigir documentação técnica de forma clara, objetiva e respeitando as regras da língua portuguesa.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e executar planos, definindo metodologias e recursos, distribuindo prazos e tarefas e estabelecendo prioridades, metas e indicadores. Acompanhar a execução das etapas, propondo redirecionamentos e avaliando resultados de acordo com os cenários.

Horário: 7:30 as 17:30 de Segunda a Quinta-feira e na sexta-feira, 7:30 as 16:15 .

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Sobre a Assetway

Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia especializada em Gestão de Ativos Digitais (DAM) . Nosso foco é atender empresas que buscam uma solução mais eficiente e personalizada para organizar seus arquivos digitais (imagens, vídeos e documentos). Oferecemos inteligência, usabilidade e eficiência para estruturar, organizar e valorizar esses ativos.

O que você vai fazer por aqui

Você atuará na linha de frente com os nossos clientes, desde conversas iniciais, passando pela implementação da plataforma até suporte técnico e o acompanhamento contínuo de toda a jornada de uso.

Sua responsabilidade principal será garantir a utilização, adoção plena e a obtenção do valor máximo da nossa plataforma por parte do cliente. Para isso, você oferecerá suporte proativo e customizado, além de treinamentos e orientações práticas, sempre alinhados aos desafios e à rotina operacional de cada organização.

Um cenário típico é uma empresa que usa Google Drive para organizar os arquivos digitais, em pastas. Seu foco será ajudar o cliente a migrar este acervo para a Assetway, fazer com que eles usem todos os recursos da maneira certa, garantir que estão satisfeitos com a plataforma e prestar suporte contínuo, próximo e personalizado.

title: Executivo comercial
description:

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: Consultor Supply Chain - SAP APO
description:
A Amaris Consulting é uma empresa de consultoria tecnológica independente que fornece orientação e soluções às empresas.

Com mais de 1000 clientes em todo o mundo, temos vindo a implementar soluções em grandes projetos, há mais de uma década – isso é possível através de uma equipa internacional de 7,600 pessoas espalhadas por 5 continentes e em mais de 60 países. As nossas soluções focam-se em quatro linhas de negócio diferentes: Sistemas de Informação & Digital, Telecomunicações, Ciências da Vida e Engenharia.

Estamos focados em construir e nutrir uma comunidade de talentos de topo onde todos os membros da nossa equipa possam alcançar todo o seu potencial.

A Amaris é a sua “stepping stone” para atravessar rios de mudança, enfrentar desafios e alcançar todos os seus projetos com sucesso.

Estamos buscando um Consultor de Supply Chain com experiência em SAP APO e conhecimento prático em OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) para atuar em projetos estratégicos de transformação digital na cadeia de suprimentos. Neste papel, você será responsável por mapear, otimizar e implementar processos de planejamento avançado (Demand, Supply, Production, Distribution e S&OP), garantindo a integração eficaz entre sistemas como SAP APO, OMP e SAP ERP .

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar clientes em todas as fases do projeto.
  • Mapear e otimizar processos de planejamento da cadeia de suprimentos:
  • Demand Planning
  • Supply Planning
  • Production Planning
  • Distribution Planning
  • S&OP (Sales & Operations Planning)
  • Configurar módulos do OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) de acordo com requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Garantir a integração eficiente entre OMP, SAP APO e SAP ERP , em colaboração com equipes de TI e negócios.
  • Realizar workshops com stakeholders para levantamento de necessidades e validação de soluções.
  • Ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave e promover boas práticas de planejamento colaborativo.
  • Prestar suporte pós-implantação , identificando oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
  • Analisar métricas de desempenho da cadeia de suprimentos e propor melhorias baseadas em dados.

Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência comprovada em implementação ou suporte a sistemas avançados de planejamento :
  • SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS)
  • OMP (Open Manufacturing Platform) – desejável
  • Outros: Kinaxis, o9, IBP (diferencial)
  • Domínio dos processos de planejamento integrado da cadeia de suprimentos .
  • Experiência com SAP ERP, SAP HANA e integração entre sistemas.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e uso de indicadores de performance (KPIs de supply chain).
  • Inglês avançado – capacidade de atuar em times globais e com clientes internacionais .

title: Agile Coach Senior
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Coach Senior , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Principais Responsabilidades

  • 1) Kanban – Upstream (Discovery)
  • Estruturar o Kanban upstream para triagem, qualificação e priorização de demanda (intake/triage, option pool, readiness policies).
  • Implementar políticas de entrada (Definition of Ready) e critérios de seleção baseados em capacidade e impacto.
  • Facilitar Upstream Kanban cadences: Replenishment, Strategy Review, Risk Review.
  • Construir classes de serviço, limites de WIP e SLAs de discovery; conectar upstream ao portfólio/OKRs.
  • 2) Kanban – Downstream (Delivery)
  • Modelar fluxos de entrega com estados claros (e.g., design → build → review → deploy → done).
  • Definir WIP, Classes de Serviço (e.g., Expedite, Fixed Date, Standard, Intangible) e Policies explícitas.
  • Medir e melhorar Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, Flow Efficiency e CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram).
  • Promover cadências: Daily Flow Review, Service Delivery Review, Operations Review e Retrospectivas orientadas a dados.
  • 3) Coaching Multinível (Chapter, Squad, Tribe, Guild)
  • Squads: coaching hands-on; facilitação de cerimônias; remoção de impedimentos sistêmicos; melhoria do fluxo.
  • Chapters: padronização de práticas, políticas e dashboards; trilhas de capacitação; comunidades de prática.
  • Tribes: governança de portfólio com Kanban Flight Levels; gestão de dependências; alinhamento com OKRs.
  • Guilds: curadoria de conteúdo; fóruns de aprendizagem; benchmarks; roadmap de maturidade.
  • 4) Jira – Expert
  • Desenhar e manter Workflows Kanban (estados, transições, validators, conditions, post-functions).
  • Configurar Boards, Swimlanes, Quick Filters, WIP Limits, Card Colors e Automation Rules.
  • Implantar dashboards executivos e operacionais: CFD, Control Chart, Lead Time percentis, Aging WIP, Throughput trends.
  • Governar schemas de issue types, fields (custom), screens, permissions, versioning e integrações (Jira Align/Portfolio, Confluence, Bitbucket, DevOps).
  • Garantir data quality e taxonomias (componentes, labels, epics, initiatives).
  • 5) Métricas, Análise e Melhoria Contínua
  • Construir e monitorar Service Level Expectations (SLEs) com percentis (e.g., P50/P85/P95).
  • Rodar análises de variabilidade, aging work-in-progress e flow debt; conduzir ações de redução.
  • Conectar métricas de fluxo a outcomes de negócio (NPS, adoção, churn, tempo de resposta, satisfação interna).
  • Reportar em ritmos executivos: Health Check por Tribe, trend de previsibilidade, capacidade x demanda.
  • 6) Change Management & Cultura
  • Conduzir jornadas de adoção (mapa de stakeholders, comunicação, treinamento, coaching 1:1).
  • Estabelecer políticas explícitas e acordos de serviço (SLA/SLE, políticas de bloqueio, políticas de revisão).
  • Promover experimentos de melhoria (kaizens) e A3 problem solving.

Mandatory skills:

  • Domínio de Kanban (upstream e downstream) com aplicação prática comprovada em múltiplos times.
  • Experiência atuando em Chapter, Squad, Tribe e Guild (estrutura de Agile at Scale).
  • Jira avançado: workflows, automations, dashboards, control chart, CFD, governance e integrações.
  • Métricas de fluxo: Lead/Cycle Time, Throughput, WIP, CFD, Flow Efficiency, Aging WIP, percentis e SLEs.
  • Facilitação de cadências Kanban e práticas de Service Delivery.
  • Experiência com gestão de dependências e portfólio em ambientes multi-equipes.
  • Habilidade de coaching, comunicação, influência e formação de comunidades.
  • Português fluente; leitura técnica em inglês.

Desirable Skills:

  • Certificações: AKC/AKP/KMP (Kanban University), PSK (Scrum.org), SAFe/Kanban Flight Levels.
  • Experiência com Jira Align, Confluence, Bitbucket/GitHub, Azure DevOps.
  • Background em Data & AI / Produto Digital B2C/B2B, e analytics orientado a valor.
  • Vivência com OKRs, product discovery, service design, SRE/DevOps.
  • Conhecimento em Lean, Theory of Constraints, Cost of Delay e Classes de Serviço avançadas.

What do we offer?

  • Health insurance

We encourage anyone interested to build a career in TCS to participate in our recruitment & selection process.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Data Science , desde a compreensão do problema até a entrega de modelos em produção;
  • Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados (Data Wrangling) para uso em análises e modelagem;
  • Desenvolver, validar e manter modelos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clustering e séries temporais);
  • Executar análises estatísticas e testes de hipótese (ex: A/B Testing) para validar insights e estratégias;
  • Construir visualizações e relatórios claros e eficazes para comunicação de resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com times de produto, engenharia e negócios , traduzindo achados técnicos em ações práticas;
  • Participar ativamente da construção de uma cultura orientada a dados , contribuindo com boas práticas e padronizações;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos em produção , garantindo melhoria contínua e rastreabilidade.

O que valorizamos

Raciocínio analítico e curiosidade intelectual: pessoas que questionam, testam hipóteses e buscam compreender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções.

Foco em impacto: profissionais que entendem o “porquê” por trás dos modelos e direcionam seus esforços para gerar valor real para o negócio.

Autonomia e colaboração: capacidade de conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com engenheiros de dados e áreas de produto.

Comunicação clara: traduzir resultados técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos de forma acessível e objetiva.

Inovação contínua: curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e aplicar novas técnicas de ciência de dados e IA.

Requisitos

  • Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn);
  • Experiência sólida com SQL para extração, manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em Machine Learning aplicado (regressão, classificação, clustering, séries temporais);
  • Base sólida em estatística e testes de hipóteses ;
  • Habilidade em visualização de dados (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI ou equivalentes);
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida completo de projetos de Data Science (da coleta ao monitoramento de modelos);
  • Boas práticas de código e programação orientada a objetos (POO) ;
  • Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e com versionamento de código (Git, GitHub, GitLab).

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas de Big Data (Spark, Databricks);
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Conhecimento em MLOps (deploy de modelos, Docker, CI/CD);
  • Experiência em Deep Learning (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch);
  • Participação em projetos de Sistemas de Recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, embeddings, modelos híbridos);
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, ChromaDB) e arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .

Modelo de contratação e ambiente

  • Contratação PJ
  • Hibrido — escritório na Zona Sul – São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte , liberdade técnica e foco em inovação
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde (disponível para CNPJs com mais de 6 meses) ;
  • TotalPass – academias, estúdios e atividades de bem-estar;
  • Alura – acesso à plataforma de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Espaço para crescimento e protagonismo , com aprendizado constante e impacto direto na estrutura financeira da empresa.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos construindo uma área de dados moderna, escalável e com papel estratégico no crescimento da Privacy.

Aqui, você terá autonomia para testar hipóteses, desenvolver modelos preditivos e contribuir diretamente para decisões que impactam milhões de pessoas.

Se você é movido por desafios, inovação e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que une tecnologia, propósito e impacto real , essa é a sua oportunidade.

title: Sales Business Development
description:
About International Digital Partners

International Digital Partners (IDP) is a consulting firm specializing in recruitment and technology services, founded by two industry executives with over 40 years of combined staffing experience. We work with clients in Brazil and abroad , connecting companies with highly qualified talent.

Our Why: We started International Digital Partners because we believe our clients should have easy access to international digital talent and quality international talent should have access to the u.s. companies that need their skills. International Digital Partners serves as this gateway - connecting great companies with exceptional international talent.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to join IDP in Brazil. The role is primarily focused on developing new business opportunities in Brazil, with responsibility for the full sales cycle and for building long-term client relationships. Why Join IDP?

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:
Position Overview

The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.

Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.

Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Customer Operations Specialist
description:
Summary

Sphere is revolutionizing global money movement by building modern financial rails with digital dollars, making transactions simple, affordable, and accessible worldwide. Through our frontend applications, APIs, low-level bank messaging optimizations, and liquidity infrastructure, businesses in emerging markets can send money across borders at scale — without depending on foreign capital or simply speaking the right languages. We combine frontier technology like stablecoins and zero-knowledge proofs with traditional banking, payments, and foreign exchange infrastructure to make global payments settle in minutes.

We’re a Seed+ startup globally distributed across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, Portugal, and the Caribbean. We’ve processed over $1B in payments volume and are backed by some of the best high-frequency trading and venture firms in the world, including TCG, Jump, Hudson River Trading, and Coinbase; as well as angels from companies like Stripe, PayPal, Brex, Visa, Revolut, Grab, Solana, Circle, and JPMorgan Chase. Our team has previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world’s leading companies (Coinbase, Vanguard, Franklin Templeton, Chainalysis, Wells Fargo) as well as at startups and accelerators like YCombinator. We’re spending the best years of our lives building Sphere, driven by a shared belief in our mission to enhance human prosperity through cutting-edge technology, creating a modern SWIFT for the 21st century and beyond.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the onboarding lifecycle of our enterprise customers, serving as their key liaison and ensuring timely setup
  • Support customers in navigating our Anti-Money Laundering requirements, including Know-Your-Customer and enhanced due diligence checks
  • Drive post-setup customer success with our enterprise customers, helping them unlock the full value of our offerings
  • Build out and manage a robust, multi-channel customer support function (email, chat), to deliver quick and effective resolutions to customer inquiries
  • Work closely with Sales & Product teams to transition customers to new product offerings or vendors
  • Proactively gather and synthesize customer needs and feedback, identifying opportunities for product/UX improvements

Requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and either Spanish or Portuguese
  • Excels at multi-tasking and rapid context switching in fast-paced environments
  • Demonstrated sense of ownership and strong project management & Organizational skills
  • Analytical, with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills

Nice to haves

  • Prior experience in a customer success, customer onboarding or customer-facing role
  • Prior experience in Compliance, Payments or Web3
  • Knowledge of SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, wire transfers, and other global payment networks.
  • Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) processes, currency conversions, and multi-currency settlement
  • Open to working flexible hours, and extended shifts, to meet business needs

Why Join Us?

  • After years navigating the idea maze, we’ve stumbled on a previously unexplored path to exponentially boost human prosperity and make the world a fairer place. Join us in making a global impact, particularly in emerging regions that are just starting to connect.
  • Have executive level impact, responsibility, and upside in an early-stage startup that has found initial product-market fit and has been growing more than 100% per month over the last year.
  • Work on some of the hardest problems in the world, leveraging frontier technology in cryptography and distributed systems to modernize payments infrastructure from 1959.
  • Unlock exceptional growth and learning opportunities in an environment that champions ownership, ambition, and innovation.
  • Join as an early employee and help us define a world-class culture of collaboration, rationality, low ego/status, customer obsession, and output. There are rare learning opportunities, and you’ll be joining just as we start to scale.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - Goiás
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Regional Business Development/sales Manager
description:
Airswift is looking for a Regional Sales Manager to work in a permanent position in Brazil for a global leader in industrial dry ice blasting, surface preparation, and industrial painting services.

This role is responsible for driving sales growth, expanding market reach, and managing relationships with key accounts in Brazil and the Northern region of South America (including Colombia, Panama, and Peru). The professional will combine business development, client engagement, and project support to ensure an outstanding customer experience and sustained revenue growth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a country-level sales strategy aligned with regional growth goals.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities in the power generation and industrial sectors.
  • Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and propose tailored solutions.
  • Manage proposal development, pricing discussions, and contract negotiations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for key clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships.
  • Represent the company in client meetings, site visits, and industry trade shows.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, competitors, and new opportunities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in industrial services or technical environments.
  • Experience with Power Plants.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with CRM systems and consultative selling.
  • Knowledge of HRSG and Thermal Engineering.

Location: Brazil

Employment Type: Permanent

Travel: Regional travel required

title: Gerente de operações
description:
A mistura de culturas é o que faz o DNA da W3 ser único. Aqui, valorizamos pessoas, conexões e experiências. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos pioneiros em comunicação digital e o nosso foco é abastecer o mercado com conteúdo relevante que gere conversas e relações marcantes. Trabalhamos para marcas icônicas como, por exemplo, OBoticário, Riachuelo, Tramontina, Santander e muitas outras que fazem parte do nosso portfólio e do seu dia a dia.

Gerente de Operações

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e estruturar processos, fluxos e rituais internos.
  • Garantir governança operacional, SLAs, produtividade e capacidade.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo de demandas e organizar prioridades do time.
  • Assegurar qualidade e prazos das entregas junto às áreas envolvidas.

  • Capacidade de equilibrar visão estratégica e atuação hands-on.
  • Organização, comunicação clara e boa análise de dados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projeto

title: Estagiário de recrutamento
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Recrutamento & Seleção para integrar o time da Brunel. A posição atua de forma híbrida, apoiando diretamente o time de São Paulo. Esta função é estratégica para dar fôlego ao time comercial, ampliando a capacidade de visitas, reuniões e relacionamento com clientes e prospects.

O(a) estagiário(a) será preparado(a) para, no futuro, assumir uma posição 360 PERM, desenvolvendo competências completas em recrutamento, atendimento a clientes e desenvolvimento de negócios.

Local: São Paulo, SP (Avenida Paulista)

Formato: Híbrido (3 vezes por semana no escritório)

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o time de SP na condução de processos seletivos.
  • Triagem de currículos, entrevistas iniciais e alinhamento de perfis.
  • Participar das rotinas e dinâmicas do time de recrutamento.

  • Agendamento de reuniões comerciais e primeiras abordagens com prospects.
  • Apoiar a estruturação de agendas, follow-ups e atividades comerciais.
  • Atuar de forma estratégica para intensificar e otimizar o pipeline comercial do time de SP.
  • Apoiar com inputs e atualizações nos sistemas internos, consumindo tempo reduzido.
  • Garantir organização das informações de candidatos e clientes.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente.
  • Facilidade e disponibilidade para deslocamento até a Avenida Paulista (SP).
  • Interesse em desenvolvimento de carreira na área comercial e de recrutamento.
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e organização.
  • Perfil resiliente, orientado a resultados e com vontade de aprender.

title: Vendedor
description:

Você é apaixonada por vendas e deseja atuar em um mercado em crescimento? Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe!

Estamos em busca de uma vendedora dedicada para integrar nossa clínica especializada em transplante capilar. Se você tem facilidade de comunicação, gosta de desafios e está em busca de uma oportunidade que valorize seu potencial, essa vaga é para você!

- Experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente no ramo da saúde ou estética.

- Foco em resultados e superação de metas.

- Proatividade, organização e comprometimento.

O que oferecemos:

- *Salário fixo* compatível com o mercado.

- Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e de fácil acesso.

- Oportunidade de crescimento dentro da empresa.

Segunda a sexta-feira das 9h às 18h

Sábado das 9h às 13h

title: Asset Management Senior Consultant
description:
Join NFQ!

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .

As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for a Senior Consultant / Manager – Asset Management to join our team in Brazil. This is a great opportunity for professionals with strong expertise in the asset management industry who are passionate about driving technological transformation in leading investment institutions.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead technology assessment projects within asset management entities, identifying gaps, opportunities, and defining transformation roadmaps.
  • Define and validate target architectures aligned with strategic business goals.
  • Conduct technical evaluations of complex architectures regarding functionality, scalability, and performance.
  • Oversee the selection, design, and implementation of core investment, portfolio management, risk, distribution, and reporting platforms.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, both local and international.
  • Interact with stakeholders from business, technology, and operations to ensure functional and technical alignment of proposed solutions.
  • Prepare functional and technical documentation, as well as executive presentations.
  • Stay up to date with the evolving technological and regulatory landscape in the Brazilian asset management industry.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in consulting or technology transformation roles within asset managers or banks with asset management operations.
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian asset management industry: local regulations (CVM, ANBIMA), products, processes, and key market players.
  • Proven experience in technology assessment and system implementation projects in the investment environment.
  • Solid knowledge of core architectures, with experience integrating with Matera considered a plus.
  • Familiarity with integration technology stacks and cloud architectures.
  • Strong background in system architecture, integration models, and data modeling.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and client management skills.
  • Advanced English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading transformation programs in large financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Jira).
  • Experience with data analytics, investment reporting, or risk systems.
  • Certifications or specialization courses in financial markets, architecture, or cloud technologies.
  • Spanish proficiency valued.

What We Offer

  • Work in a dynamic, international environment with global mobility opportunities.
  • Continuous learning and official certifications.
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • A personalized development plan with mentorship and performance-based growth.

CLT Contract Benefits

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • And much more: a flexible work environment, internal events, travel, and wellness initiatives

Learn more about us: nfq.es | NFQ LinkedIn

Location: Brazil (Hybrid/Remote)

Ready to lead the digital transformation of the asset management industry? Apply now!

title: Coordenador de Central - Sapezal/MT
description:
Se você se identifica com uma organização focada em sustentabilidade e inovação, venha fazer parte do inpEV!

O inpEV (Instituto Nacional de Processamento de Embalagens Vazias) é uma entidade sem fins lucrativos que transforma o Brasil em referência mundial na logística reversa de embalagens de defensivos agrícolas. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e ajude a construir um futuro mais sustentável!

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Operação :

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.

Requirements :

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.

About John Deere & the Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.

For 2025, John Deere is accelerating its focus on autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support this expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to develop and scale applications that enhance digital products and services.

As a Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack (Front-End Heavy), you will primarily contribute to the design and development of modern front-end applications using React, while occasionally working on backend services. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI), to enhance customer-facing applications.

You will leverage technologies like React, APIs, cloud platforms, and AI/GenAI tools to create intuitive, scalable, and secure applications that improve the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development – Build scalable, high-performance front-end applications using React.
  • UI/UX Collaboration – Work closely with designers and product teams to deliver intuitive, customer-centric interfaces.
  • Backend Integration – Contribute to backend development when needed, with a focus on Python or Java (differential).
  • API Development & Integration – Connect front-end solutions with APIs and ensure smooth data flow across platforms.
  • Cloud & DevOps Enablement – Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment.
  • Technology Exploration – Evaluate and adopt emerging tools, including ML/GenAI, to drive innovation and improve productivity.
  • Quality & Security by Design – Apply best practices in coding, testing, and security to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Deliver modern, React-based user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend systems.
  • Ensure front-end solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute across the stack when necessary.
  • Support the adoption of AI and GenAI to enhance customer-facing applications.
  • Maintain alignment with John Deere’s vision for autonomous operations, AI, and digital optimization.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Must-have: Extensive hands-on experience with React and front-end frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on user experience.
  • Collaborative mindset, willing to contribute to both front-end and backend tasks.
  • Differential: Experience with Python or Java for backend development.
  • Differential: Experience in Machine Learning (ML) or Generative AI (GenAI) projects.
  • Differential: Exposure to multi-cloud environments or full-stack design patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to collaborate in an international environment.

Location: Indaiatuba, SP

Model: Hybrid – 3x per week at the office
